Binding.0005.description: Manual binding redirects exist but are missing a redirect for a referenced assembly with a version mismatch. This can cause MissingMethodException or FileLoadException when the missing redirect allows the app to start but fails when a specific code path is hit.
Binding.0005.label: Missing binding redirect for referenced assembly

Binding.0006.description: An explicit binding redirect targets a different version than what auto-generation would produce. MSBuild will throw MSB3836 conflict error because it cannot determine which redirect wins.
Binding.0006.label: Manual redirect conflicts with auto-generated version

Binding.0007.description: A binding redirect's newVersion is lower than the version provided by the NuGet package. This forced downgrade usually causes a load failure at runtime because the expected assembly version is not available.
Binding.0007.label: Binding redirect forces version downgrade

Binding.0008.description: An assembly reference version differs from the version provided by the target NuGet package and no binding redirect covers this range. This causes FileLoadException because the CLR cannot resolve the version mismatch.
Binding.0008.label: Assembly version mismatch with insufficient redirect coverage
